site.name: Piepcheck
site.tagline: Help with checking in and out using OVpay

home.title: What happened?
home.intro: Choose what happened to you. You will then get short steps to follow.

common.sourceNote: The information on this site comes from ovpay.nl, ns.nl, gvb.nl and htm.nl. Last checked on 21 September 2026. Rules and amounts can change, so check the transport company's website if you are unsure.

help.text: Call OVpay customer service: 0900-1433 (standard call charges), on weekdays from 07:00 to 17:00. Calling from outside the Netherlands? Use +31 10 892 5063.
help.servicePoint: Rather talk to someone? At Amsterdam Centraal, GVB Tickets & Info is opposite the main entrance. Open Monday to Friday from 08:00 to 20:00 and at the weekend from 08:30 to 19:00. For train journeys, go to the NS Tickets & Service desk in the station hall. Bring the card or phone you checked in with.

links.label: NS: forgot to check in or check out

S1.title: You may have paid twice
S1.intro: If you hold your whole wallet or phone case against the reader, two cards can check in at the same time. You then see two payments starting with NLOV.
steps: Open your banking app and look for two payments starting with NLOV. A journey usually appears one day after you check out.
Did you carry more cards or your phone? Check your other accounts too. The second payment may be at another bank.
Go to reisoverzicht.ovpay.nl. Enter the reference number (the digits and letters after NLOV) and the amount that was charged. Click Reis zoeken (search journey).
Do this for both payments. That shows you whether it really is the same journey.
Were you charged twice? Ask for the extra amount back through your journey overview, or call OVpay on 0900-1433.
You then get the amount back in your account. Expect this to take a few days.
S1.note: To avoid this next time: take one card out of your wallet and hold only that against the reader.

links.label: Look up your journey at OVpay

S2.title: You forgot to check out
S2.intro: If you do not check out, the transport company does not know where your journey ended. You then pay a fixed amount: the correction or boarding fare. That is usually more than your journey cost. You can put this right yourself.
steps: Are you still at the station and is it less than 6 hours since you checked in? Then you can still check out at a gate or post.
Not possible? Then wait until 6 hours after your journey. After that you can correct the missed check-out.
In your banking app, find the payment starting with NLOV. Note the reference number and the amount.
Go to reisoverzicht.ovpay.nl, look up your journey and fill in the station or stop where you got off.
Did you travel by GVB tram, bus or metro? Then arrange it at ovpay.gvb.nl/mijn-gvb/reishistorie.
You get the amount you overpaid back in your account within 5 days.
S2.note: You have 60 days to correct a missed check-in or check-out. For the train this is allowed 3 times per calendar year. For bus, tram and metro 3 times per half year. At GVB the fare for a missed check is €4.00 (full fare); on the train the amount is higher.

links.label: Look up your journey at OVpay
Travelled with GVB? Go to Mijn GVB

S3.title: The gate did not open or showed a red cross
S3.intro: A red cross means the reader does not accept your card. Often there is a simple cause.
steps: Step aside so other people can pass. Take one card or your phone out of your wallet and calmly try again. Hold the card still against the reader.
Do you want to check out? Then use the same card you checked in with. Another card will not work.
Nothing happens? Check in your banking app whether contactless payment is switched on for that card.
Is there still an unpaid amount from an earlier journey? Then your card may be blocked for public transport. Call OVpay on 0900-1433 to check this.
Have a look at ovpay.nl/storingen to see whether there is a malfunction right now.
Gate still closed? Ask a member of staff or a service point in the station. Do not keep trying yourself: every attempt can count as a new check-in.
S3.note: Not sure whether you are checked in? Hold your card against the reader again within 100 seconds. That does not check you in again, but it shows whether your check-in worked.

S4.button: I do not know which card I used
S4.title: Which card did I use?
S4.intro: You have to check out with the same card or phone you checked in with. If you do not, your journey stays open and you pay too much.
steps: Did you pay with your phone or watch? Then the card set as the default card was used. Check your wallet app to see which one that is.
Look in your banking app to see which account has a payment starting with NLOV. That is the card you used. Note that the payment usually only appears a day later.
Are you at the gate right now and not sure? Try to check out with the card you use most often.
Do not hold all your cards against the reader one by one. You could accidentally check in again with another card.
Cannot check out? Ask a member of staff or a service point in the station for help.
Was your journey not closed properly? Correct it at reisoverzicht.ovpay.nl. You can do that from 6 hours after your journey and up to 60 days afterwards.
S4.note: Do you use the OVpay app? It shows your journeys up to 18 months back, so you do not have to search in your banking app.

links.label: Look up your journey at OVpay

S5.button: I want to check my journey or payment
S5.title: Check your journey or payment
S5.intro: Every OVpay journey has a reference number. That is the series of digits and letters after NLOV in your banking app, also called the payment reference. You use it to look up your journey.
steps: Open your banking app and find the payment for your journey. The description shows NLOV followed by digits and letters. Sometimes www.ovpay.nl is shown too.
Nothing there yet? A journey usually only appears one day after you check out.
Copy the digits and letters after NLOV. That is your reference number.
Go to reisoverzicht.ovpay.nl. Enter the reference number under Betalingskenmerk and the amount charged under Bedrag. Click Reis zoeken (search journey).
You now see where you checked in and out and what the journey cost.
Something not right? Correct the journey on the same page, or call OVpay on 0900-1433.
S5.note: Travel often? The OVpay app shows all your journeys together, up to 18 months back. Then you do not need the reference number.

banks.title: Choose your bank (optional)
banks.intro: Every banking app looks a little different. Choose your bank for steps that match your app. Not sure? The general steps above work too.
banks.disclaimer: Banking apps change regularly. Does your app look different? Then find the payment and open its details. The description with NLOV is shown there.

items.name: ING
steps: Open the ING app and tap your payment account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
Under Omschrijving (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number. Press and hold to copy the text.

items.name: Rabobank
steps: Open the Rabo App and choose your payment account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
Under Omschrijving or Mededeling (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: ABN AMRO
steps: Open the ABN AMRO app and choose your payment account.
Tap the payment and then tap Details.
Under Omschrijving (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: bunq
steps: Open the bunq app and tap your account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
The description shows NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: SNS
steps: Open the SNS app and choose your payment account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
Under Omschrijving (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: ASN Bank
steps: Open the ASN app and choose your payment account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
Under Omschrijving (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: RegioBank
steps: Open the RegioBank app and choose your payment account.
Tap the payment for your journey.
Under Omschrijving (description) you see NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: Revolut
steps: Open the Revolut app and go to your transactions.
Tap the payment for your journey.
The description shows NLOV followed by your reference number.

items.name: Other bank
steps: Find the payment for your journey in your banking app.
Open the details of that payment.
Look for the code starting with NLOV. The digits and letters after it are your reference number.
Cannot find it? Call your bank or OVpay on 0900-1433.

checkin.title: How to check in safely
checkin.intro: These three steps prevent most problems.

steps.title: Take one card out of your wallet
steps.text: Do not hold your whole wallet or phone case against the reader. Two cards can then check in at the same time and you pay twice.

steps.title: Hold the card still against the reader
steps.text: Wait until you hear a beep and see a green sign. Only then are you checked in. Not sure? Hold your card against the reader again within 100 seconds. That does not check you in again.

steps.title: Check out with the same card
steps.text: When you get off, use exactly the same card or phone as when you checked in. Otherwise your journey does not count as finished.

checkin.note: Did you forget to check out after all? From 6 hours after your journey you can correct this yourself at reisoverzicht.ovpay.nl, up to 60 days after the journey.
